title: Compare confident AI answers
description: These two answers show that fluent prose does not signal whether a claim is supported.

steps.description: The first question asks for water's boiling point at sea level. The answer gives 100°C and 212°F.
The second question asks about a specific intramural tournament. Its answer names a winner and student details.
The page identifies the first answer as verifiable and correct, but describes the second as almost certainly fabricated despite the same authoritative tone.
